name: tool-search-loads-and-calls
description: End to end on the runtime: the model searches two exact names, the tool_search result lists both and the same batch appends tools_loaded with their pinned spec_refs; the next request renders their full specs; the model then calls one and it runs. Both requests are pinned by hash: line 0 (the declared prefix) is the same, and the second request's bytes extend the first's.
